name: toolu
description: Dual-host engineering quality plugins and delivery workflow.

plugins.name: toolu
plugins.description: Dual-host engineering discipline for Claude Code and Codex: workflow skills, agents, commands, and registry-driven quality hooks.

plugins.name: ast-grep
plugins.description: Structural code search & rewrite (ast-grep): skill, wrapper, and a PreToolUse Grep→ast-grep nudge registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: python-quality
plugins.description: Python PostToolUse quality checks registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: rust-quality
plugins.description: Rust PostToolUse quality checks registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: ts-quality
plugins.description: TypeScript PostToolUse quality checks registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Host-native project status: a persistent Claude Code statusline plus an explicit Codex status skill for repository, gate, git, comemory, and Jev readiness. Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: toolu-review
plugins.description: Project-tuned pre-push code review mirroring CI falconiere/toolu-ghactions/code-review@v8 (Jev-enabled), writing the toolu push-review state so the gate passes. Standalone.

plugins.name: pr-babysit
plugins.description: Babysit a PR until review threads, the review-bot verdict, and CI are clear, using Claude cron or a durable Codex goal; fixes run on Jev-routed Claude Code, Codex or Cursor Agent sessions in a herdr worktree.

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: Think a change through before building: evidence-backed triage, alternatives, trade-offs, and a recommended approach, without editing code. Standalone, and phase 1 of delivery-flow. No dependencies.

plugins.name: delivery-flow
plugins.description: One dual-host delivery skill for brainstorm, approved spec and plan, real-data execution, PR creation, and pr-babysit handoff.

plugins.name: epic-orchestrator
plugins.description: Drive a GitHub, Jira, or Linear epic to merged PRs: dependency graph, herdr worktrees, parallel Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / OpenCode workers routed by Jev complexity, merge gate, rate-limit and progress guardrails.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Typed judgments from TypeSafe's Jev model at runtime (skill + REST wrapper) — yes/no probabilities, choices, and scores a script can branch on. Standalone, no dependencies.
